source.note: The fact script is locked by projects/easel-enhanced-golden/evidence/evidence-lock.json and is not edited. This creator script is a spoken-register derivative for the voice track. The v2 spoken script (narration-spoken.json) stays as the historical v2 artifact; this file is the v3 editorial output.

principles: Narrative order may change: the hook asks the question first, the definition comes next, evidence follows, the turn reveals the catch.
Details that are noise for a listener may be dropped only when declared in omitted_details with a reason.
Questions and transitions are allowed when they introduce no new fact; questions are capped so not every beat creates suspense.
No fabricated experience or emotion: every first-person marker declares its basis (the original's own first person or an editorial judgement).
Template marketing language is refused by the validator.
changes_vs_v2: v2 was 96.9% character-identical to the written original (measured in narration-v3-diagnosis.md); v3 re-orders to a conclusion-oriented hook and removes written-register fillers.
The definition of Easel moves before the version evidence so the hook's question is answered in context.
Dependency package names (fastapi, uvicorn) are omitted as listener noise; the six-failure count and the 'dependencies not installed' fact stay.
A value unit and a natural ending unit are added, both built from the original's own conclusion sentences.

preserved_facts: 真能被调起来的生产引擎

omitted_details.reason: package names are listener noise; the facts they support (six checks failed, dependencies not installed) are preserved in the text

units.text: 装了 Easel 之后，最先要回答的只有一个问题：它到底跑不跑得起来？
facts_used: 开场问题：Easel 是否跑得起来

units.text: 在回答之前，先把它是什么讲清楚：它不是一个 SaaS，而是一层 Skill 库。114 个 Skill，分成发现、策划、创作、发布、归因五层——创作层最大，有 52 个。
版本我锁在 v0.2.1。982 个文件，逐个比对过哈希，和上游 tag 完全一致。
units.first_person_basis: paragraph 2 itself is first-person: '我把它锁在 v0.2.1' -- the marker is the original's own voice, not a fabricated experience

units.text: 跑起来之后，doctor 是绿的：Python、Node、FFmpeg 都过了；ping 里，Agent 的真实往返也通了。
但有个坑：网关健康检查探的是写死的默认端口，和 Easel 实际网关端口对不上——那一行，是红的。
facts_used: 网关健康检查端口不匹配

units.text: 更直接的是 Web 工作台这条路：六项没过。依赖没装，前端也没构建，.env 里也没有 API Key——所以 Web 界面，到现在还没验证。
所以它值不值得用？我的判断是：看路线——走 CLI 和 Skill 这条线，它真能被调起来；想要开箱即用，它现在还不是。
facts_used: 结论的两种读法：可用与不可用
units.first_person_basis: editorial value judgement ('我的判断'), not an experience claim; it restates the original's own conclusion halves and adds no fact

units.text: 一句话收尾：Easel 不是开箱即用的产品，但它是一个真能被调起来的生产引擎——CLI 和 Skill 这条线，今天是通的。
facts_used: 可被调起来的生产引擎
CLI 与 Skill 线今天可用

sample.note: Hook question -> version evidence -> the turn. A standing arc for the D/E/F listening test: it asks, it proves, it reveals. Chosen over the v2 opening because it contains the emotional turn the director is supposed to shape.
